description: The Karl Bohnak for State Representative campaign hosted former Secretary of State and current Wayne State Board of Governors member Terri Lynn Land and current Michigan Republican Chairman Peter Hoekstra on Wednesday, May 29th at their campaign headquarters. Over 50 people were in attendance to hear Karl and his guests speak on the state of affairs
